wins.text: Gross margins expanded 120 bps to 45.4%, driven by lower product costs, lower warehousing/logistics costs, and strategic pricing benefits
New footwear products revenue up strong double digits YoY in Q1; Sabrina grew ~5x, Kobe nearly 4x, Alphafly nearly 3x, and 'look of running' lifestyle segment grew more than 4x over the past year
Running specialty partners in North America up double digits in Q1, with holiday and spring order books sustaining that momentum; men's and women's running footwear returned to positive growth in Q1
Pegasus 41 launch delivered mid-teens growth above prior Pegasus model; spring '25 running footwear units in order books growing double digits
NIKE owned over 60% of total share of voice during Paris Olympics; Jordan's first Twitch livestream drove over 10 million views, the biggest ever activation for any brand on the platform

risks.text: Q1 revenue declined 10% reported / 9% currency-neutral; NIKE Digital down 20%, NIKE Direct down 12%, Wholesale down 7%; traffic declines across NIKE Direct more significant than anticipated
Full-year guidance withdrawn due to CEO transition; Investor Day postponed; spring '25 order books came in roughly flat vs. prior year, slightly lighter than planned
Q2 gross margins guided down ~150 bps due to higher promotions, channel mix headwinds, and supply chain deleverage; full-year gross margins now expected to decline vs. prior year
Greater China Q1 revenue down 3% with NIKE Digital down 34% and NIKE Direct down 16%; elevated marketplace inventory in an already promotional environment; near-term outlook moderated
East Coast port strike flagged as a potential unquantified risk to near-term supply chain and margins; not yet baked into guidance

guidance_items.detail: Q2 revenues expected down 8%-10% YoY; full-year guidance withdrawn; revenue expectations moderated since start of year due to traffic trends, retail sales, and lighter spring order books
Q2 gross margins guided down ~150 bps YoY; full-year gross margins now expected to decline vs. prior year, a deterioration from prior guidance
Q2 SG&A roughly flat YoY; other income/expense (net interest) $30M-$40M; effective tax rate in high teens range

Jordan brand expected down double digits for full fiscal '25; NIKE Digital expected to decline double digits for full fiscal '25; classics franchise headwind of mid-single digits on revenue expected to continue through the year
